 Nagaland State Lottery Sambad Dear Vision Saturday result for November 14, 2026 
 Nagaland State Lottery Sambad Dear Vision Saturday result for November 14, 2026
 Here is the official result of the Nagaland State Lottery Sambad Dear Vision Saturday at 1 pm on November 14, 2026 
 Published: November 14, 2026, 2:46 PM Updated: November 14, 2026, 2:53 PM By Eastern Mirror News Lottery Share WhatsApp Channel Get EM News Bites DIMAPUR — The   Nagaland State Lottery results  for the   Dear Vision Saturday draw, held on Saturday, at 1 pm, have been declared. 
 According to the official information provided by the Nagaland State Lotteries, the winning number of   Dear Vision Saturday , the 54th draw held at 1 pm Saturday, is 93L 72824 the winner of the 1st prize will receive INR 1 crore for a ticket priced at INR 7. 
 Here is the official result of the Nagaland State Lottery Sambad Dear Vision Saturday at 1 pm on November 14, 2026 
 Nagaland State Lottery Sambad Dear Vision Saturday result for November 14, 2026 
 Where to claim prizes 
 The winners of Nagaland State Lottery draws must present their winning tickets, along with a completed claim form available online, a government-recognized photo ID, and passport-size photographs in order to claim their prizes. 
 Nagaland State Lottery results are also accessible on the official Nagaland Lotteries website, Lottery Sambad, and Eastern Mirror. Director Zhothisa Dawhuo stated that the lottery results can also be viewed on YouTube channels including Nagaland Lotteries, Nagaland Dear Lottery, Nagaland Lottery,  Nagaland State Lottery Live , and Nagaland Dear Laxmi.
